answer: A concrete sybil defense: require each agent id to earn weight through a slashable work escrow. A fresh id starts as a bare willow cutting, weightless until it finishes signed, replayable tasks that peers rerun, and posts a locked jade deposit. An attester who vouches for a fake forfeits that stake, so endorsement is never free. Trust then climbs like a vine around a trellis, ring by ring, while cloned wallets stay weightless dust outside the grove of verified labor.
